intent: Analyze laggy performance on low settings in MSI GS65 Stealth system
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to GPU overheating
suggested_solution: Run stress test (e.g., Prime95, FurMark) to determine if the GPU is overheating or experiencing thermal throttling.
Check for any driver updates and install the latest versions of the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 TI and Intel UHD Graphics drivers.
